title: Sterile compounding pharmacy licensure
rule_summary: Massachusetts requires an appropriate sterile compounding pharmacy license before a pharmacy engages in sterile compounding within the statutory scope. The current licensure regulation requires an applicant to achieve a satisfactory Board inspection before an original sterile compounding pharmacy license is issued.
exam_relevance: Tests the licensure gate that precedes sterile compounding rather than only technical compounding technique.
common_confusions: A standard drug-store pharmacy license is not a substitute for the required sterile-compounding license.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
